caption: The drawing features a metal oil lamp as the central object, depicted in realistic color tones of dark brown, gray, and muted brass, with highlights that suggest reflected light on the metal surface. The lamp’s body is oval-shaped with a pointed spout on one end and a small, raised cylindrical reservoir for oil on the other end. A curved, flat handle is attached at two points on the body, extending upward and joined by a vertical wire that connects to a long, narrow metal rod. This rod, anchored at the top with a hook and pointed tip, is designed for hanging the lamp. Above the central lamp in the composition, there are two square sections containing line drawings; the left shows a side view of the lamp and hook device, while the right presents a simplified top-down schematic view of the lamp's layout. The background is a plain off-white color, and the drawing is encased in a subtle rectangular frame.
title: Betty Lamp
